namespace: Orchestrate independent background subagents for concurrent execution.
instructions: Use subagent_list to inspect status and historyDir paths. Use msg_write to agent addresses, or your children.sock to broadcast to direct active agents without opening custom socket connections. Messaging a stopped agent revives it for a new round. A message from another session carries its full session identity in `from` and one managed reply address.

create.description: Create background subagents for concurrent execution, non-blocking. Returns agent IDs and socket addresses.
create.snippet: Delegate parallel workloads to direct subagents
create.guideline:
Write requirements in English. subagent_create is non-blocking: after dispatching, continue non-dependent local work or conclude your turn to let the host wake you on completion. DO NOT poll.

Offloading and coordination

Use subagents to offload tasks that do not need to run inline in your current flow, or to advance independent workstreams in parallel. Keep tightly coupled sequential steps local, or isolate overlapping file edits in separate git worktrees for you to merge. Sequence dependent stages explicitly.

Fresh vs Inherited

Use inheritContext: false (default) for a self-contained assignment routed to a role-matched model. Because a fresh subagent starts with a clean context, provide thorough instructions in context and task: background, constraints, scope, deliverables, and how to verify completion.

Use inheritContext: true when multiple complex workstreams need to advance concurrently on top of your current session context, decisions, and active capabilities (e.g. implementing multiple features in parallel). Because the child already shares your context, DO NOT repeat extensive background—delegate the workstream goal, boundaries, and which key choices require reporting back, and expect it to drive execution autonomously.

parameters.context: Background, constraints, and source material shared by every task in this batch.

tasks.description: Independent workloads. Order is preserved in the result, but it does not create execution dependencies.

items.name: Caller-facing label; defaults to none.
items.task: Self-contained assignment: scope, deliverables, and how to verify completion.
items.inheritContext: Inherit this session's conversation and capabilities. Default false: start with clean context.

create.capacity: Active-children caps: at most {fresh} fresh and {inherited} inherited children per parent. A batch or revival that would exceed either cap is refused; running children are not stopped when a cap changes.

list.description: Returns a scoped tree of related agents, non-blocking (parent, peers, and direct children; capped at 4 per group, active first). Active direct children are expanded; stopped nodes are folded. Nodes carry latest history paths, and durable roots include historyDir (<jobId>/summary.md for outcomes, transcript.jsonl for logs; inspect via read).
list.snippet: Check background agent progress and history paths

parameters.all: Show every agent without group limits or folding. Default false.
parameters.id: Filter to a specific agent's visible subtree. Returns null if absent.

stop.description: Request cancellation of an agent by id, non-blocking. May return stopping or finalizing while execution or history writes finish.
stop.snippet: Cancel a background agent's current run

msg_write.description: Send a plain-text message to a managed Agent IPC endpoint: Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe. The host binds the sender and transport framing. Omit from/to, JSON or NDJSON envelopes, and trailing newlines. A path that is another live session's Main endpoint reaches that session's Main; that session sees your session identity and a reply address.
msg_write.snippet: Send plain-text messages to agents through their Socket paths
guidelines: Provide the message body as plain text content; do not add from/to, JSON/NDJSON framing, a trailing newline, or a custom Socket client.

parameters.path: Returned Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe address, including another live session's Main endpoint from /subagent sessions.
parameters.content: Plain-text message body. The host frames the transport and binds the sender.
